verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents its own automations that end by opening a pull request. Examples include detecting failed workflows and opening a PR with a proposed fix, and remediating security alerts and opening a PR. Its general automation feature integrates with GitHub and runs on schedules or webhook events. However, the evidence only shows auto-PR as the outcome of specific automation templates, not as a general setting for any agent task. Missing for 10: documented general configuration to auto-open a PR on completion of any task, PR settings (branch, title, draft or reviewers), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to automatically open a pull request when its task completes

citations.quote: Detect failed workflows, inspect logs, identify the likely cause, and open a pull request with a proposed fix.
Review security alerts, validate the finding, update affected code, and open a pull request with the remediation.
Create automations and workflows that integrate with Slack, GitHub, Linear, and more. Run on a schedule or in response to webhook events
